mapper.select: SELECT ML.ITEM_CODE AS itemCode ,ML.YYYYMM AS matYyyyMm ,ML.INITIAL_QTY AS matInitialQty ,(ML.INPUT_QTY + ML.EXTRA_INPUT_QTY) AS matInputQty ,ML.AGING_PERIOD AS matAgingPeriod ,'BOM' AS matItemType FROM MATERIAL_INV_BAL ML WHERE ML.YYYYMM = (SELECT MAX(ML2.YYYYMM) FROM MATERIAL_INV_BAL ML2 WHERE ML2.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYyyyMm} AND #{toYyyyMm} AND ML2.ITEM_CODE = ML.ITEM_CODE AND ML2.DIVISION_CODE = ML.DIVISION_CODE AND ML2.COMPANY_CODE = ML.COMPANY_CODE AND (ML2.ISSUE_QTY + ML2.EXTRA_ISSUE_QTY) > 0) AND ML.ITEM_CODE = #{c.itemCode} AND ML.DIVISION_CODE = #{c.divisionCode} AND ML.COMPANY_CODE = #{c.companyCode} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ML.ITEM_CODE AS itemCode ,ML.YYYYMM AS matYyyyMm ,ML.INITIAL_QTY AS matInitialQty ,(ML.INPUT_QTY + ML.EXTRA_INPUT_QTY) AS matInputQty ,ML.AGING_PERIOD AS matAgingPeriod ,'FUNGIBLE' AS matItemType FROM FUNGIBLE_MATERIALS FM INNER JOIN MATERIAL_INV_BAL ML ON ML.ITEM_CODE = CASE WHEN FM.ITEM_CODE = #{c.itemCode} THEN FM.FUNGIBLE_ITEM_CODE ELSE FM.ITEM_CODE END AND ML.DIVISION_CODE = FM.DIVISION_CODE AND ML.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE AND ML.YYYYMM = (SELECT MAX(ML2.YYYYMM) FROM MATERIAL_INV_BAL ML2 WHERE ML2.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYyyyMm} AND #{toYyyyMm} AND ML2.ITEM_CODE = ML.ITEM_CODE AND ML2.DIVISION_CODE = ML.DIVISION_CODE AND ML2.COMPANY_CODE = ML.COMPANY_CODE AND (ML2.ISSUE_QTY + ML2.EXTRA_ISSUE_QTY) > 0) WHERE (FM.ITEM_CODE = #{c.itemCode} OR FM.FUNGIBLE_ITEM_CODE = #{c.itemCode}) AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = #{c.divisionCode} AND FM.COMPANY_CODE = #{c.companyCode} AND FM.DELETE_YN = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS poCount ,COALESCE(SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT), 0) AS warehousingAmountSum FROM PO_LEDGER PL LEFT OUTER JOIN COO_DIVISION_V D ON D.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND D.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.FTA_CODE = #{ftaCode} AND ECD.COO_YN = 'Y' WHERE ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4' AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND ECM.DIVISION_CODE = CASE WHEN ECM.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'F' THEN PL.DIVISION_CODE WHEN ECM.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'D' AND ECM.APPLY_TYPE = 'A' THEN ECM.DIVISION_CODE WHEN ECM.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'D' AND ECM.APPLY_TYPE = 'M' THEN D.COO_RECEIPT_DIVISION_CODE END AND ((ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN ECD.APPLY_DATE AND ECD.END_DATE) OR (ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'N' AND PL.WAREHOUSING_NO = ECD.WAREHOUSING_NO AND PL.SEQ = ECD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ)) AND ECD.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE) AND PL.ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode} AND PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
